items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, regardless of the number of visits. One gross flat rate is estimated at €83.
Necessary sealing material is covered under §7.1.7(c). One unit is estimated at €25 gross.
Section 2.4.3(a) covers the failed indoor supply pipe, but §§3.5 and 7.1.9 cap reimbursement at the standard-grade, original-bore equivalent. One metre of equivalent pipe is estimated at €45 gross.
Necessary fittings are covered under §7.1.7(c), but §§3.5 and 7.1.9 exclude the designer premium. Two standard original-bore fittings at €25.50 each give €51 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow the cost of restoring the original plain rock-wool insulation, not the cladding upgrade. One metre of plain rock wool is estimated at €28 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installation labour at customary rates, provided it does not duplicate technician labour under §7.1.8(c). The one-metre installation is estimated at €110 gross using the comparable bathroom repair rather than the mixed installation prior.
Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.9 allow the labour reasonably needed for a like-for-like repair, not extra time for the upgrade. The comparable nine-unit labour charge is estimated at €834 gross in total.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. The single flat rate is estimated at €595 gross.

items.description: Close and paint the disturbed wall area
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the necessary access opening and repainting the disturbed patch, not unaffected surfaces. The local repair is estimated at €647 gross.
